PR (cited in the notes as #22299): fix(test): delete CRD between tests, install CRD before syncing CRs [closed]
`TestDuplicatedResources` started failing when I [enabled annotation-based tracking by default](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/22289). It turns out that the test always fails locally, because unlike in CI, the `ClusterDummy` CRD isn't left around by a previous test.

This change adds a label so that the CRD gets cleaned up between tests. I also had to add a sync wave annotation to the CRD in `TestDuplicatedResources`, because otherwise resource deduplication fails. The CRD …

knows the `ClusterDummy` resources are cluster-scoped and will dedupe with namespace set to `""`.

It remains to be seen whether the test will continue to fail after enabling annotation-based tracking. But at least it won't fail locally for a silly reason.
